# Repo Notes for AI Agents
- Scope: SDK for Zerodha Kite REST + WebSocket. Core modules `kiteconnect/connect.py` (HTTP client), `kiteconnect/ticker.py` (Twisted+Autobahn streaming), `kiteconnect/exceptions.py` (error taxonomy).
- REST shape: all endpoints keyed in `_routes`; always call via `_get/_post/_put/_delete` -> `_request` to attach headers (`X-Kite-Version`, `Authorization api_key:access_token`, UA) and honour `self.reqsession`, `timeout`, `proxies`, `disable_ssl`, optional pool adapter.
- JSON handling: `_request` accepts only `content-type` containing `json` or `csv`; raises `DataException` otherwise. API errors set `status:error` or `error_type`; mapped to exception classes and invoke `session_expiry_hook` on 403 TokenException.
- Auth: set `api_key` at init; call `generate_session`/`renew_access_token` to set `access_token` automatically; `set_access_token` available for reuse of stored tokens. `login_url()` builds browser redirect.
- Response shaping: `_format_response` converts timestamp strings to `datetime`; `_format_historical` structures candles; `_parse_instruments`/`_parse_mf_instruments` cast numeric fields and parse dates from CSV. Prefer these helpers when adding endpoints that return similar payloads.
- Orders/GTT: Order helpers accept `None`-filtered `locals()` dict before POST/PUT. GTT payload validated in `_get_gtt_payload` (type checks trigger_values, required order keys); reuse for new GTT flows.
- WebSocket: `KiteTicker` built on `KiteTickerClientProtocol` + `KiteTickerClientFactory` (Twisted ReconnectingClientFactory). Ping/Pong loops guard ghost connections; callbacks `on_ticks/on_connect/on_close/on_error/on_message` set on factory. Reconnection limited by `maxRetries`, `maxDelay`; `reconnect=False` bypasses.
- Defaults: root `https://api.kite.trade`, login URL `https://kite.zerodha.com/connect/login`, timeout 7s, header version `3`. Instruments can be large; parsing assumes 10-char dates for expiry/last_price_date.
- Exceptions: use specific subclasses (`TokenException`, `PermissionException`, `OrderException`, `InputException`, `DataException`, `NetworkException`) so tests and session hooks work. Do not bypass `_request` or raise raw `Exception` for API errors.
- Testing: default `pytest` config (`pytest.ini`) runs `tests/unit` with doctests and verbose flags. Unit tests rely on `responses` mocks + fixtures in `tests/unit/conftest.py`; mock payloads live in `tests/mock_responses` with routing map in `tests/helpers/utils.py`. Integration suite: `pytest -s tests/integration/ --api-key <key> --access-token <token> --cov-report html:cov_html --cov=./`. Coverage-friendly unit run: `pytest -s tests/unit --cov-report html:cov_html --cov=./`. Alias `python setup.py test` calls pytest.
- Style/lint: `flake8` max line length 119; ignores D100,D401,E501 and excludes examples/tests. Stick to ASCII unless file already uses otherwise.
- Examples & docs: runnable samples in `examples/*.py` (REST + ticker usage). Docs generation via `pdoc --html --html-dir docs kiteconnect` after installing `pdoc`.
- External deps to note: `requests`, `python-dateutil`, `six`, `twisted`, `autobahn`. Twisted reactor used directly in ticker; respect its threading model.
- When adding endpoints: extend `_routes`, write helper mirroring existing patterns, add mocked fixture path in `tests/helpers/utils.py`, create JSON/CSV samples in `tests/mock_responses`, and cover via `responses`-driven unit tests.
